basic_info.description: Welcome to 1479 27th Avenue. A timeless Central Sunset gem where classic San Francisco charm meets everyday comfort. From the moment you step inside, you're welcomed by sunlit rooms, gleaming hardwood floors, and the warmth of original craftsmanship. A spacious living room with elegant built-ins and graceful windows invites both relaxation and entertaining, while the formal dining room is perfect for hosting memorable meals. Unlike many city homes, the original wood moldings and trims remain beautifully unpainted, preserving authentic period character. The bright, roomy kitchen features ample cabinet space and a cozy breakfast nook, an ideal spot to start your day. Three cheerful bedrooms and a classic split bath complete the main level. Downstairs, a flexible retreat offers an additional bedroom, full bath, or bonus space, perfect for guests, a home office, or extended family. A large two-car garage with abundant storage adds practicality and future expansion potential. Outside, a private oversized yard extends the living space, perfect for gardening, lounging, or outdoor gatherings. Located just blocks from vibrant Irving Street and Golden Gate Park, with easy access to public transit, this home offers both tranquility and city convenience in the heart of the Sunset!
